# Emergency Dentists Harlow

> Free same-day matching with vetted, GDC-registered emergency dentists
> across Harlow and the surrounding CM17 / CM18 / CM19 / CM20 / CM21
> postcodes. Toothache, abscess, knocked-out tooth, broken tooth, lost
> filling or crown. Matched within an hour during opening hours.

Emergency Dentists Harlow is a free referral and matching service. We do
not perform clinical work. We connect Harlow patients in genuine dental
need to GDC-registered emergency dentists who can see them the same day.
Specialists pay us a referral fee on accepted bookings; the patient never
pays a markup.

## Emergencies covered

- [Severe toothache](https://www.emergencydentistsharlow.co.uk/services/severe-toothache/): Same-day triage for sustained, sleep-disrupting tooth pain (likely pulpitis or apical periodontitis).
- [Knocked-out tooth (avulsion)](https://www.emergencydentistsharlow.co.uk/services/knocked-out-tooth/): Time-critical replantation pathway. Same-hour matching during opening hours.
- [Broken or chipped tooth](https://www.emergencydentistsharlow.co.uk/services/broken-or-chipped-tooth/): Sharp-edge stabilisation, restoration, or extraction depending on the fracture line.
- [Lost filling or crown](https://www.emergencydentistsharlow.co.uk/services/lost-filling-or-crown/): Same-day re-cementation or temporary protection of the exposed dentine.
- [Dental abscess and facial swelling](https://www.emergencydentistsharlow.co.uk/services/dental-abscess/): Drainage, antibiotic prescription where indicated, and definitive treatment of the source.
- [Evening, weekend and bank-holiday emergencies](https://www.emergencydentistsharlow.co.uk/services/out-of-hours/): Out-of-hours pathway through partner clinics with extended-hours rotas.
- [Wisdom tooth pain](https://www.emergencydentistsharlow.co.uk/services/wisdom-tooth-pain/): Pericoronitis triage, irrigation, and onward referral for surgical extraction where indicated.

## Areas served

Harlow town and the wider CM postcodes: Old Harlow, Church Langley,
Newhall, Sumners, Staple Tye, The Stow, Mark Hall, Netteswell,
Sawbridgeworth, and Roydon. Coverage extends across CM17, CM18, CM19,
CM20, and CM21 with secondary coverage into the surrounding parts of
West Essex and East Hertfordshire.

## Clinical scope and safety

Content is general information about dental emergencies. Nothing on the
site is clinical advice for an individual patient. For genuine medical
emergencies including uncontrolled bleeding, spreading facial swelling,
breathing difficulty, or trauma to the head and neck, call 999 or NHS 111.
We do not diagnose or treat; we introduce patients to GDC-registered
clinicians who do.
